lines.text: Dooba Dooba Har Pal Yaado Me
Apne Me Hi Khoya Rehta Hu
Kehna Hai Kuch Kuch Kehta Hu
Pain Ajab Sa Sehta Hu Dil Kya Kare
Din Bhar Kuch Miss Karta Hu
Aata Hai Aaram Kahi Na Dil Kya Kare
Ho Mai Jo Baithu To Baitha Rahu
Der Tak Ho.. Chal Padu To Me
Ho Raaste Bhool Jata Hu Main
Shirt Ke Na Hosh Button Ke
Bajjte Hai Sab Sur Dhadkan Ke Dil Kya Kare
